descriptionHtml:
Suggestion A1 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was P2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Buttons, inputs and dropdowns have no accessible name (Nursing Home +, settings, back, close X, task done/delete, medication status dropdown); also some focus jumps to the top and small tap targets

Tickets: — · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-01/S21, OAT-06/S24b, TC-03/S21, TC-11/S20, TC-14/S22, TC-19/S21, TC-21/S20, TC-22/S20

Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S20 Visual lane: Important Points states under axe, labels and focus, on phone profiles and WebKit

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes. (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.3; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U2 Three points added via '+ Add Point', one per line, show as three separate cards, not one merged card, in both Hospital and Nursing Home (Nursing Home per PR #57). (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U4 Editing one point and deleting another both work, in both modes, and the result is what is stored. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Hospital editor open with the S04 twelve points (one card in edit mode, the Add Point box open); Nursing Home Pre-Round tab with three cards, and its editor open; Chromium desktop, iPhone 15 (393x852, WebKit) and Pixel 7 (Chromium) profiles

When The visual lane opens each state, runs axe and the explicit label and focus checks, scrolls the points list and takes screenshots

Then No serious or critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations; Edit point / Delete point / Cancel edit have accessible names; each point textarea (Add Point and edit) has aria-label, aria-labelledby or a <label> (a placeholder does not count); after clicking Add Point focus is in that textarea, and after Save Point or Cancel it returns to Add Point or the new card. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core: zero serious or critical (visual-checks.ts). axe's 'label' rule accepts a non-empty placeholder, so the label check is explicit: the textarea's accessible name comes from aria-label / aria-labelledby / <label>, not the placeholder. Focus: document.activeElement after each click. …

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (blocked)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Suggestion · our own check · environment local · tickets TFA-92590 in progress

The Add Point and edit-point boxes are labelled only by placeholder, and the Hospital edit box has no label at all. Keyboard focus drops to the top of the page after Save Point or Cancel, and the Nursing Home edit and delete icons are 17×17 px on phones.

Evidence: allure c16872e7, visual lane: 56 passed, 36 failed. Fails WCAG 2.4.3 (focus order) and 2.5.8 (target size). The layout passes: 12 points scroll, a 500-character point wraps, and the buttons are named.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: visual.

UAT item: TC-12 Important Points · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-12/S20

Tickets: TFA-92590 Important Points (in progress)

New local lane visual: status failed in visual/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (visual/plan.json, automatable: partly): preround.spec.ts: Hospital editor with the S04 twelve points (scroll, 500-char point, edit mode, Add Point open, Save Point / Cancel focus) and NH tab with three points + Add Point + editor; axe, button names, strict textarea labels (placeholder does not count), focus via document.activeElement, phone visibility/reach. — The iOS keyboard covering the box is a device check (S22).

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 56 judged check(s) passed, 36 failed. 12 points scroll inside their box to QA-PT-11 and 'K'; the 500-character point wraps and its end is visible; Edit point / Delete point / Cancel edit are named; focus goes into the Add Point box when it opens.

Product issue: The Add Point and edit-point textareas are labelled only by placeholder (Hospital edit box has none) — oracle requires aria-label/labelledby/<label>. After Save Point or Cancel, keyboard focus is dropped to the page body instead of returning to Add Point or the new card (WCAG 2.4.3), so a keyboard / switch user must start over from the top. On phones the NH Edit point / Delete point icons are 17×17 px, side by side (< 24 px, no spacing exception).

Evidence: 7 attached; 1 not attached:

  • visual/evidence/TC-12_S20 — a folder (45 items), not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
